en: An old monochrome postcard showing a large, multi‑storey historic building with a steep, tiled roof and many shuttered windows, standing beside a pond that reflects the structure. Two figures are visible walking along a stone embankment in front of the building. Trees frame the view. The caption at the top in red Gothic‑style script reads "Schloß Börnichen b. Öderan." and a small red publisher line appears at the bottom.
